declared.statement: Declared before the first run (2026-11-02): C_D is judged for a converged SA run on the CellBase coarse grid, at the case's residual_orders, with alpha set so that C_L = 0.500 +/- 0.005 (otherwise not comparable), against the DPW4 core statistics for coarse grids (Morrison, AIAA 2010-4673, Tables 2-3): median 279 counts, sigma 8.8; within 2 sigma passes. The median covers the participants' own coarse grids (3.2 M to 11.5 M points), so the scatter includes the grid effect: a pass is 'within the workshop scatter', not agreement on the same grid. No DPW4 participant ran a cell-centred solver on CellBase (Vassberg et al., AIAA 2010-4547, Tables I and III). FUN3D is compared for time only.

cd_reference.source: J. H. Morrison, Statistical Analysis of CFD Solutions from the Fourth AIAA Drag Prediction Workshop, AIAA 2010-4673, Tables 2 and 3 (case 1a: M 0.85, C_L 0.500, Re 5e6, iH 0 deg; 21 core solutions). https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20100025032/downloads/20100025032.pdf
cd_reference.scope: participants' own coarse grids (3.2 M to 11.5 M points): within the workshop scatter, not same-grid agreement

fun3d_cd.note: Nastac et al. Table 3, at alpha fixed at 2.41 deg (not lift-controlled), no reference area, C_L or drag split published; 143.6 counts is about half the workshop's ~280 counts, most likely a full-span reference area (an inference, not stated in the paper). Not an agreement target until its normalisation is established and cited.
